<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition (formation of two C‑C bonds and conversion of two C=C bonds to C‑C). This can be captured by specifying that two C=C bonds are broken and two C‑C bonds are formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_broken": ["6-6", "6-6"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
